summary.headline: Venus in the Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological delineations of Venus in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, and the Moon, describing fortune, women, marriage, health, intellect, and reputation; Chapter V begins with Venus’s significance.
